defects.title: A nonzero right hand side b is not scaled with the bounds
defects.trigger: LPp.A = sparse([1 -1; 1 0]); LPp.b = [0; 1]; LPp.csense = ['E';'E']; LPp.lb = [0;0]; LPp.ub = [10;10]; model.S = LPp.A(1,:); V = LP9weighted([1;1], 2, 1, model, LPp, 1e-4) (gurobi)
defects.observed: '0 = sol.stat', 'INFEASIBLE = sol.origStat', warning 'LP solution may not be optimal' (line 83), V = [NaN NaN]: core bound scaled to 10 (line 64), bounds scaled (67-68), b unscaled (line 56) (R2025a, 2026-11-23)
defects.expected: an optimal solution (v = [1;1] is feasible for the unscaled problem), as LP10 returns for the same problem (it scales b, LP10.m line 145)

defects.title: The bound of the auxiliary variables ignores the weights
defects.trigger: LPz.A = sparse([1 -1]); LPz.b = 0; LPz.csense = 'E'; LPz.lb = [0;0]; LPz.ub = [10;10]; mz.S = LPz.A; V = LP9weighted([2;1], 2, 1, mz, LPz, 6) (gurobi)
defects.observed: '0 = sol.stat', 'INFEASIBLE = sol.origStat', V = [NaN NaN]: line 68 bounds z(P) by max(|ub(P)|,|lb(P)|)*1e5 = 1e6 while z(P) >= W(P)*|v(P)| = 1.2e6; with W = [1;1] the same call returns V = [600000 600000] (R2025a, 2026-11-23)
defects.expected: an optimal solution (v = [6;6] is feasible; the help text allows any nonnegative W), z(P) bounded by W(P) times the flux bound

notes: Checked independently from its own source: same code as LP10weighted (only the help text differs), both defects confirmed with gurobi. Reproduction (MATLAB): changeCobraSolver('gurobi','LP',0); LPp.A = sparse([1 -1; 1 0]); LPp.b = [0; 1]; LPp.csense = ['E';'E']; LPp.lb = [0;0]; LPp.ub = [10;10]; model.S = LPp.A(1,:); V = LP9weighted([1;1], 2, 1, model, LPp, 1e-4) % -> NaN NaN, INFEASIBLE; with LPp.b = 0 on LPz.A = [1 -1] it returns [10 10]. Second: LPz.A = sparse([1 -1]); LPz.b = 0; LPz.csense = 'E'; LPz.lb = [0;0]; LPz.ub = [10;10]; mz.S = LPz.A; LP9weighted([2;1], 2, 1, mz, LPz, 6) % -> NaN NaN, INFEASIBLE; LP9weighted([1;1], 2, 1, mz, LPz, 6) % -> 600000 600000. Not recorded as defect: V is returned in the 1e5-scaled units (V(K) >= 1e5*epsilon), as in the original FASTCORE LP9 (findSparseModeWeighted only thresholds the support; LP10 precedent). Reach: only caller findSparseModeWeighted (line 44) <- fastCoreWeighted (lines 46, 58), which passes LPproblem = buildOptProblemFromModel(model) (b = model.b, plus coupling rows) and the user's weights: both defects depend on data (nonzero b; W(P)*epsilon above the flux bound), not on a call form, so default seed unless the lead narrows it. Tier 3 with gurobi.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: lines 67-68 scale lb and ub by scalingfactor 1e5 while beq = LPproblem.b (line 56) is not scaled, as in LP10weighted; the auxiliary bounds (line 68) ignore W of line 59; writer's gurobi reproductions; default seed: data-dependent (non-zero b, weights above 1), fastCoreWeighted passes model.b and the user's weights)

defects.title: The stoichiometric matrix of the LP is zero
defects.trigger: 6-reaction model m1 of GREEDY/testFluxConsistency.m (m1.b = zeros(4,1)); [fc, sol1] = checkFluxConsistency(m1, 1e-8); m2 = m1; m2.S = zeros(4,6); [fc, sol2] = checkFluxConsistency(m2, 1e-8) (gurobi)
defects.observed: sol1.stat = sol2.stat = 1, sol1.obj = sol2.obj = 1.2e-07 (= 2*n*epsilon), max(abs(sol1.full - sol2.full)) = 0: line 21 [model.S - model.S] is a subtraction (zero matrix); with b = [1;0;0;0] the LP is infeasible; with m3.S = sparse([1 0; 0 0]) (both reactions blocked) obj = 2*n*epsilon again (R2025a, 2026-11-23)
defects.expected: an LP built from model.S (comment of line 21 'assumes all reactions are reversible', blocks [S -S] of line 31), whose solution depends on the stoichiometry

notes: Reproduction (MATLAB): changeCobraSolver('gurobi','LP',0); S=zeros(4,6); S(1,1)=-1; S(2,1)=1; S(2,2)=-1; S(3,2)=1; S(3,3)=1; S(1,3)=-1; S(2,4)=-1; S(4,4)=1; S(1,5)=1; S(3,6)=-1; m1.S=S; m1.b=zeros(4,1); [fc,sol1]=checkFluxConsistency(m1,1e-8); m2=m1; m2.S=zeros(4,6); [fc,sol2]=checkFluxConsistency(m2,1e-8); max(abs(sol1.full-sol2.full)) % 0, both obj 1.2e-07. fluxConsistent is [] on every call (documented 'empty', not a defect). Reach: every call; only caller is the script src/reconstruction/modelGeneration/fluxConsistency/GREEDY/testFluxConsistency.m ('does not work yet'; it also fails at its line 25 on the undefined fluxConsistentBool). Prototype code: the lead may prefer EXCLUDED, but the brief's rules give QUARANTINED.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: line 21 S=[model.S - model.S] is a zero matrix; the comment 'assumes all reactions are reversible' shows [model.S, -model.S] was meant; kept QUARANTINED, not EXCLUDED: ordinary source with a clear defect)

defects.title: The documented defaults of direction and flux are not implemented
defects.trigger: fm = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'a','b','c'}, {'a -> b','b -> c','c -> '}); r = findNearRxns(fm, {'R2'}); r = findNearRxns(fm, {'R2'}, 'sub')
defects.observed: 'Not enough input arguments.' (MATLAB:minrhs) at line 67 for the two-input call and at line 72 for the three-input call (R2025a, 2026-11-23); only 'struc' runs without flux
defects.expected: direction = 'struc' and flux = zeros when omitted (help text, OPTIONAL INPUTS)

defects.title: A call that selects no metabolite fails
defects.observed: 'Array indices must be positive integers or logical values.' (MATLAB:badsubscript) at line 188: metIndexes keeps its placeholder -1 (line 59); with flux = [1;1;1] the call returns {'R2','R1'} (R2025a, 2026-11-23)
defects.expected: Rxns returned with no neighbour added (zero flux is the documented default)

defects.title: A row cell Rxns with more than one reaction fails
defects.observed: 'Index in position 1 exceeds array bounds. Index must not exceed 1.' (MATLAB:badsubscript) at line 268 (Rxns{w,1} on a 1 x 2 cell); the column cell {'R2';'R3'} returns {'R2';'R3';'R1'} (R2025a, 2026-11-23)
defects.expected: the same result as for the column cell (help text: cell array of reaction abbreviations, no orientation)

notes: Tier 2 in the test header: no solver is used (the ledger says 3). Reach: callers draw_by_met (line 207) and bio_draw_by_met (line 165; it resolves to this file, not to bio_findNearRxns) always pass four inputs and a column cell involvedRxns, so defects 1 and 3 are confined to call forms they do not use; defect 2 depends on data: draw_by_met with radius > 1 and direction 'sub'/'prod'/'both' reaches it when none of the selected reactions has a matching metabolite (for example 'sub' when the only reaction producing metAbbr is an uptake exchange); not reproduced through draw_by_met (existing test testPaint4Net_draw_by_met.m). Lead to decide whether draw_by_met/bio_draw_by_met are seeds. Reproduction (MATLAB): fm = createModel({'R1','R2','R3'}, {'a','b','c'}, {'a -> b','b -> c','c -> '}); findNearRxns(fm,{'R2'}) % minrhs; findNearRxns(fm,{'R2'},'sub',zeros(3,1)) % badsubscript at 188; findNearRxns(fm,{'R2','R3'},'struc',[1;1;1]) % badsubscript at 268; findNearRxns(fm,{'R2'},'struc') returns {'R2','R1','R3'}.
confirmed_by: lead (read the code: metIndexes(1) = -1 (line 59) is a sentinel later used as an index when no metabolite is selected; the documented defaults of direction and flux are not set; writer's MATLAB reproductions; default seed: the sentinel defect depends on the data (radius, direction, reactions without a matching metabolite), which draw_by_met passes through)
